note: Night of 8 Aug 1974: crowds around car radios and storefront TVs. The President is never named.

lines.text: He's going. He's actually going. Tomorrow noon.
I never thought I'd hear a President say that.
First time in history. And I'm standing next to a hot-dog cart.
Whatever you thought of him, it's a sad night for the country.
Turn it up! Turn it up! The cabbie's got the best radio!
If a President can go down, anybody can. Anybody.
And tomorrow the rent's still due.
Times Square's never been this quiet. Listen to that.
